|strategy=By [mailto:bobafett@powerup.com.au Michael Sharp], Gold 29<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20010628234712/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/demotion.html</ref>

Is a particular Imperials' gametext annoying you? Simply play [[Demotion]] on them, and kiss their gametext goodbye!

This card is particularly useful against the [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]/[[Grand Moff Tarkin]] combo. Play on [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]], and the Dark Side can no longer cancel one of the Light Side's battle destiny draws. [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] also becomes power -2 in this instance.
